level: DEV DATA WRITE through the product's own function (no migration, no function, no Edge change)
ownerAuthorization: Owner 2026-10-07, answer d15 on the plan decision page: "Zatvori ih na DEV-u" (the four old test tasks from 2026-08-30 without any place that can never reach the map).
why: Four open POINT_TO_POINT test tasks ("Hitno prenošenje troseda", created 2026-08-30, revision 1) have no geography, no place and no city, so no public map point can ever exist for them; they only add noise to the open-task list and to matching.
mechanism: One guarded transaction. Precondition block: exactly these 4 ids, status PUBLISHED, revision 1, approx_geog null, one requester account, no Agreement (raises unless all hold). Then, with the requester's identity set in request.jwt.claims for the transaction only, public.rpc_cancel_need(need_id, 1, 'Zadatak je zatvoren.') once per task — the same function the app calls, so responses expire, pending deliveries are stopped, dispatch rounds and schedules are cleared and the terminal NEED_CANCELLED event is emitted by the product's own rules.
revert: None: a cancelled task is a terminal state of the product (the requester can re-publish). Not planned.
limits: The cancellation created 4 IN_APP deliveries and 1 PUSH delivery in state CREATED (3 PUSH SUPPRESSED by PUSH_OFF) for the NEED_CANCELLED events. Push transport is still disabled; the one CREATED PUSH row must be retired like the 8 older ones before transport is ever enabled (decision A24 / push last).
The 2026-09-26 TICKET_PENDING attempt and every other delivery were not touched.
No flag, device, Edge secret or transport setting changed.
